## Customer Story

**Customer:** Thomson Reuters - Global content and technology company

**Challenge:** Internal teams spending excessive time on routine platform engineering tasks - cloud provisioning, DB patching, network configuration, architecture reviews

**Solution:** Platform engineering hub ("Aether") where internal teams request infrastructure changes through natural language. Central orchestrator delegates to specialized agents for cloud provisioning, DB patching, network config, and architecture reviews.
